what: The big menu words are stacked in two sets (thin serif · a different typeface like blackletter). On hover the front set slides 25% to the right, blurring to 10px as it vanishes, while the back set enters from 25% left, clearing the blur into place (.5s cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1)) — the typeface blurs as it changes clothes. The current page (aria-current) takes the back set

options.[data-fx-part=next]: Back-row word (child, aria-hidden) — the same word in a different typeface and color

from.where: shared.css .bf-nav__item (big words in the menu drawer) — original span (serif glyph image) opacity 1→0 · translate 0→25% · blur 0→10px, strong (blackletter glyph image) translate −25%→0 · blur 10px→0, all .5s cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1). The current section (.is-active) is kept in blackletter

note: Also spins when you hover the parent link or button. The back copy is absolute, so it overflows if wider than the front copy — match the font size so it fits within the same width
